title: stelis asperilinguis
intro: Stelis asperilinguis, commonly known as the Rough-Lipped Stelis, is a species of orchid native to Central and South America. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Stelis asperilinguis are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids that exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. Further research is needed to fully understand the bioactive constituents and potential therapeutic applications of Stelis asperilinguis.
